description: XONIDU is an open-source development team from UNAM FES Cuautitlán, focused on software engineering, automation, and hardware, currently competing in the Challenge 13 Space Mission Design Game. We bring a proven track record, having secured 2nd place at the IA FESC 2026 Hackathon and 4th place at the Mobility and AI 2025 Hackathon. If you want to build a realistic, playable, and scientifically grounded space simulator, come join us.
